comparison.objective: Rearrange shelf boxes to create a carton-sized gap; candidate tunes and locks an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Shelf work tests object relocation and spatial packing. Candidate tests tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, tightening, and dynamic-response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: The carton must fit after end-state rearrangement; candidate must achieve two repeatable safe carriage stops under numeric physical constraints.
comparison.reason: Spatial rearrangement does not test adjustment or commissioning of a retained damping mechanism; detailed shelf scoring thresholds are absent but immaterial to this distinction.
